response.sql:
WITH patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(PIC) as avg_pic,
    AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) as ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
mean_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_mean_ratio
  FROM patient_stats
),
kept_patients AS (
  SELECT ps.ID, ps.avg_pic, ps.ratio
  FROM patient_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN mean_ratio mr
  WHERE ps.ratio > mr.overall_mean_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(kp.avg_pic) as mean_avg_pic,
  AVG(kp.ratio) as mean_ratio,
  AVG(kp.ratio - mr.overall_mean_ratio) as mean_difference
FROM kept_patients kp
CROSS JOIN mean_ratio mr

assumptions.assumption: The hemoglobin-to-hematocrit ratio per patient is computed as AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT)—the ratio of separately averaged components—rather than AVG(HGB / HCT), the average of per-record ratios.

alternatives.interpretation: The hemoglobin-to-hematocrit ratio per patient is the average of individual record-wise ratios: AVG(HGB / HCT) rather than the ratio of separate averages.
